summary: SDK 58 upgrade + Firebase removal regression. Backend: 54/54 pytest pass (new test_email_pin_auth.py 15/15 after fix + 39 existing). Found & FIXED a CRITICAL backend bug: POST /api/auth/reset-password always returned 500 whenever a reset code existed, and a 2nd POST /api/auth/forgot-password within 60s returned 500 (TypeError naive vs aware datetime – Motor client not tz_aware). Frontend (390x844 web preview): app loads, login screen shows ONLY email/password + 'Créer un compte' + 'Mot de passe oublié ?' + ambassador link; Ionicons font loaded and icons render; signup -> dashboard (no PIN prompt shown on signup); login test@tekateka.com works; all tabs (Accueil/Vendre/Stock/Charges/Dettes/Plus=settings) navigate with no crash or console errors; forgot-password sends request and shows reset form; product add with EUR + kg unit (unit picker bottom sheet opens) -> edit -> currency EUR kept (verified in POST/PUT payloads/responses); sale, expense, debt recorded and reflected on dashboard; settings loads; delete-account modal opens & cancels (no DELETE call); subscription screen loads; ambassador screen opens. Found & FIXED 'Unexpected text node' error (empty string rendered in View) in CurrencyAmountInput (would be a crash risk on native). No deprecated packages (expo-av/barcode-scanner/background-fetch) and no SafeAreaView-from-react-native imports found.

critical.issue: FIXED BY TESTER: 500 'TypeError: can't compare/subtract offset-naive and offset-aware datetimes'. Motor returns naive datetimes; code compared with datetime.now(timezone.utc). Password reset was completely broken. Fix: AsyncIOMotorClient(MONGO_URL, tz_aware=True) in auth_email_pin.py:73.

minor.issue: MONGO_URL/DB_NAME/RESET_CODE_PEPPER have hardcoded default fallbacks (os.getenv(..., default)); should fail fast. Default pepper 'tekateka_default_pepper_replace_me' is insecure if env missing.

ui_bugs.issue: Row ACHAT/U, TOTAL, 'Vente:', Promo and margin use formatCurrency(value, userCurrency) on the product's raw native-currency value with no conversion: a 2 EUR product shows '$2,00'/'$20,00' while header 'Inventaire' correctly converts to $21,60. Reference: app/(tabs)/products.tsx:394,396,402,406,411
Preview uses user currency instead of formCurrency: shows '$20,00' while picker is €. Reference: app/(tabs)/products.tsx:533
ACHAT/U value ('$2,00') visually collides with the SKU badge/name column at 390px width

issues: Two redundant trial banners ('Essai gratuit 7 jours restants' card + '7 jours restants Passez a un abonnement' card)
Password eye toggle has no accessibilityLabel (innerText is raw icon glyph)

react_native_issues.issue: FIXED BY TESTER: `{value && ...}` rendered empty string inside <View> -> 'Unexpected text node' error on web, 'Text strings must be rendered within <Text>' crash risk on native. Changed to `!!value &&`. Reference: components/CurrencyAmountInput.tsx:58
FIXED BY TESTER: same pattern `{editQty && ...}` -> `!!editQty`. Reference: app/(tabs)/sell.tsx:382

Almost no testIDs across app (LoginScreen, tabs, settings, subscription, ambassador). Tester added only: products-add-button, product-save-button, product-unit-picker-trigger, expenses-add-button, expenses-save-button, debts-add-button, debts-save-button, sell-record-button.

rca_of_issue: reset-password/forgot-password 500: AsyncIOMotorClient default tz_aware=False returns naive datetime for created_at/expires_at stored as aware UTC; `row['expires_at'] < datetime.now(timezone.utc)` and `datetime.now(timezone.utc) - created_at` raise TypeError. Repro: POST forgot-password twice for an existing email (2nd = 500), or POST reset-password with any code after forgot-password (500). Mitigation applied: tz_aware=True.
